name: ListCloud — Free 24/7 Cloud OpenList
description: Host your own standard or custom OpenList instance on the cloud 100% free without a credit card, accessible from any device via HTTPS URL.

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial administrator username for your OpenList instance

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial administrator password for your OpenList instance

DATABASE_URL.description: Optional free PostgreSQL connection string (e.g. from Neon.tech or Aiven) for 100% permanent data across container rebuilds

SYNC_MODE.description: Automatic SQLite cloud backup mode when DATABASE_URL is not used: none | hf | github | webdav

CUSTOM_TITLE.description: Custom site title for your OpenList portal

CUSTOM_BINARY_URL.description: Optional URL to a custom-built OpenList binary or .tar.gz release

ENABLE_ARIA2.description: Enable built-in Aria2 offline download engine (true/false)
